name: imagetracker-infrastructure
description: Minimal AWS Serverless foundation for ImageTracker

scripts.deploy: python scripts/stage_service.py --install-dependencies && serverless package --config .build/serverless.yml --stage prod --package .build/.serverless && python scripts/validate_foundation.py --stage prod --packaged-template .build/.serverless/cloudformation-template-update-stack.json && python scripts/deploy_packaged.py --stage prod
